name: barbell one arm snatch
description: A one-handed snatch that takes the bar from the floor to overhead in one fast pull. Needs power and coordination.
instructions: Stand over the center of the barbell with your feet wider than hip-width apart.
Grip the bar near its center with one hand and brace your trunk, keeping your free arm clear of the bar.
Push through the floor and extend your hips and knees to accelerate the bar upward close to your body.
Move under the bar and lock the working arm overhead, controlling the long barbell's balance.
Stand tall, lower the bar carefully, and change arms after the set.
